label: GitHub Actions Platform
content:
GitHub provides Ubuntu runners (virtual machines) that:
- Execute your workflows (.github/workflows/)
- Have Docker, Node.js, and other tools pre-installed
- Run in GitHub's cloud infrastructure
- Communicate with external services via HTTPS APIs

label: Docker Build Process
content:
Docker build happens on GitHub's runners:
- Reads your Dockerfile
- Builds 4 images (codechart, license-api, landing-page, docs)
- Tags with git SHA
- Pushes to GitHub Container Registry (ghcr.io)

label: GitHub Container Registry
content:
GHCR is GitHub's Docker registry:
- Stores your Docker images
- Accessible via ghcr.io/codechart/
- Your K8S cluster pulls images from here
- Integrated with GitHub Actions

label: Pulumi CLI Execution
content:
Pulumi CLI runs on GitHub's runners:
- Reads your TypeScript infrastructure code
- Makes API calls to Linode to create/update resources
- Sends logs and state to Pulumi Cloud (app.pulumi.com)
- Does NOT host anything itself

label: Linode Infrastructure
content:
Linode provides:
- Physical servers in eu-central region
- Kubernetes cluster (LKE) with 1x g6-standard-1 node
- DNS management for use-covalent.com domain
- Network and storage for your applications

label: Kubernetes Cluster
content:
K8S cluster runs on Linode servers:
- Manages container orchestration
- Handles service discovery, load balancing
- Provides persistent storage volumes
- Exposes services via nginx-ingress

label: Application Containers
content:
Your apps run as containers in K8S:
- codechart: Node.js API + Angular UI
- license-api: Go microservice
- landing-page: React static site
- docs: MkDocs documentation
- All pull images from GHCR

label: Database Container
content:
PostgreSQL runs as container in K8S:
- Uses Bitnami Helm chart
- Has 10Gi persistent storage
- Exposed on NodePort 32345
- license-api connects via K8S service discovery

label: Pulumi Cloud Service
content:
app.pulumi.com provides:
- Web dashboard for deployment logs
- State storage for infrastructure
- History of deployments and failures
- Does NOT execute deployments (CLI does that)

label: Communication Flow
content:
API communication:
- GitHub Actions → Linode API (via Pulumi CLI)
- K8S cluster → GHCR (pulls images)
- Pulumi CLI → Pulumi Cloud (logs/state)
- End users → Linode IP → K8S services
